text.p: Campbell Soup Co. said Monday it realigned its business structure, forming a division that combines international and speciality foods.

Campbell International and Speciality Foods will bring together bakery & confectionery, international grocery, global food service and frozen & speciality foods, the company said. The new division's sales have exceeded $4 billion so far this year.

Campbell's other operating division, U.S. Grocery, combines U.S. Soup and the Meal Enhancement groups, with 1996 sales of more than $3 billion. It includes such brands as Campbell's soups, Pace Mexican sauces, Prego spaghetti sauce, Franco-American pasta and V8 vegetable juice.
Dale Morrison was promoted to president of Campbell International and Speciality Foods from president of the Pepperidge Farm business.
Robert Bernstock continues as president -- U.S. Grocery and a corporate senior vice president, the company said.
The realignment and appointments are effective as of Dec. 2.
Camden, N.J.-based Campbell's stock rose 25 cents to $83.125 on the New York Stock exchange.
